kernels.name: elementwise_add
kernels.kernel: __global__ void add_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n) out[idx] = a[idx] + b[idx];}

kernels.name: elementwise_mul
kernels.kernel: __global__ void mul_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n) out[idx] = a[idx] * b[idx];}

kernels.name: elementwise_sub
kernels.kernel: __global__ void sub_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n) out[idx] = a[idx] - b[idx];}

kernels.name: elementwise_div
kernels.kernel: __global__ void div_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n) out[idx] = a[idx] / b[idx];}

kernels.name: elementwise_exp
kernels.kernel: __global__ void exp_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n) out[idx] = expf(x[idx]);}

kernels.name: sigmoid
kernels.kernel: __global__ void sigmoid_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if(idx < n){float v = x[idx]; out[idx] = 1.0f/(1.0f+expf(-v));}}

kernels.name: gelu
kernels.kernel: __global__ void gelu_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int n){const float inv_sqrt2=0.70710678f; int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<n){float v=x[idx]; out[idx]=0.5f*v*(1.0f+erff(v*inv_sqrt2));}}

kernels.name: tanh
kernels.kernel: __global__ void tanh_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<n) out[idx]=tanhf(x[idx]);}

kernels.name: fused_bias_add_relu
kernels.kernel: __global__ void bias_relu_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ bias, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<n){float v=x[idx]+bias[idx]; out[idx]=v>0?v:0;}}

kernels.name: reduction_sum
kernels.kernel: __global__ void reduce_sum_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int N){extern __shared__ float sdata[]; unsigned int tid=threadIdx.x, i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x*2+tid; float sum=0; if(i<N) sum=x[i]+(i+blockDim.x<N?x[i+blockDim.x]:0); sdata[tid]=sum; __syncthreads(); for(unsigned s=blockDim.x/2; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sdata[tid]+=sdata[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} if(tid==0) out[blockIdx.x]=sdata[0];}

kernels.name: reduction_max
kernels.kernel: __global__ void reduce_max_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int N){extern __shared__ float sdata[]; unsigned int tid=threadIdx.x, i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x*2+tid; float m=-FLT_MAX; if(i<N) m=fmaxf(x[i], (i+blockDim.x<N?x[i+blockDim.x]:-FLT_MAX)); sdata[tid]=m; __syncthreads(); for(unsigned s=blockDim.x/2; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sdata[tid]=fmaxf(sdata[tid], sdata[tid+s]); __syncthreads();} if(tid==0) out[blockIdx.x]=sdata[0];}

kernels.name: reduction_mean
kernels.kernel: __global__ void reduce_mean_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ out, int N){extern __shared__ float sdata[]; unsigned int tid=threadIdx.x, i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x*2+tid; float sum=0; if(i<N) sum=x[i]+(i+blockDim.x<N?x[i+blockDim.x]:0); sdata[tid]=sum; __syncthreads(); for(unsigned s=blockDim.x/2; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sdata[tid]+=sdata[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} if(tid==0) out[blockIdx.x]=sdata[0]/N;}

kernels.name: argmax
kernels.kernel: __global__ void argmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ vals, int* __restrict__ idxs, int stride){extern __shared__ float svals[]; extern __shared__ int sidx[]; int tid=threadIdx.x, base=blockIdx.x*stride; float best=-FLT_MAX; int best_i=-1; for(int i=tid;i<stride;i+=blockDim.x){float v=x[base+i]; if(v>best){best=v; best_i=i;}} svals[tid]=best; sidx[tid]=best_i; __syncthreads(); for(int s=blockDim.x>>1; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s&&svals[tid+s]>svals[tid]){svals[tid]=svals[tid+s]; sidx[tid]=sidx[tid+s];} __syncthreads(); } if(tid==0){vals[blockIdx.x]=svals[0]; idxs[blockIdx.x]=sidx[0];}}

kernels.name: prefix_sum_scan
kernels.kernel: __global__ void scan_kernel(const int* __restrict__ x, int* __restrict__ out){extern __shared__ int temp[]; int th=threadIdx.x, offset=1; temp[2*th]=x[2*th]; temp[2*th+1]=x[2*th+1]; for(int d=blockDim.x; d>0; d>>=1){__syncthreads(); if(th<d){int ai=offset*(2*th+1)-1, bi=offset*(2*th+2)-1; temp[bi]+=temp[ai];} offset*=2;} if(th==0) temp[2*blockDim.x-1]=0; for(int d=1; d<2*blockDim.x; d*=2){offset>>=1; __syncthreads(); if(th<d){int ai=offset*(2*th+1)-1, bi=offset*(2*th+2)-1, t=temp[ai]; temp[ai]=temp[bi]; temp[bi]+=t;}} __syncthreads(); out[2*th]=temp[2*th]; out[2*th+1]=temp[2*th+1];}

kernels.name: matrix_multiplication_gemm
kernels.kernel: __global__ void gemm_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ B, float* __restrict__ C, int M, int N, int K){int row=blockIdx.y*blockDim.y+threadIdx.y, col=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; float sum=0; if(row<M&&col<N){for(int k=0; k<K; ++k){sum+=A[row*K+k]*B[k*N+col];} C[row*N+col]=sum;}}

kernels.name: conv2d_forward
kernels.pytorch: out = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, weight, bias, stride, padding)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q){int n=blockIdx.z, k=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x/Q, q=blockIdx.x%Q; float acc=b?b[k]:0; for(int c=0;c<C;++c){for(int r=0;r<R;++r){for(int s=0;s<S;++s){int h=p+r, w_=q+s; if(h<H&&w_<W){int xi=((n*C+c)*H+h)*W+w_, wi=((k*C+c)*R+r)*S+s; acc+=x[xi]*w[wi];}}}} if(threadIdx.x==0) y[((n*K+k)*P+p)*Q+q]=acc;}}

kernels.name: max_pool2d_forward
kernels.kernel: __global__ void maxpool2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int KH, int KW, int P, int Q){int n=blockIdx.z, c=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x/Q, q=blockIdx.x%Q; float m=-FLT_MAX; for(int kh=0;kh<KH;++kh){for(int kw=0;kw<KW;++kw){int h=p+kh, w_=q+kw; if(h<H&&w_<W) m=fmaxf(m, x[((n*C+c)*H+h)*W+w_]);}} y[((n*C+c)*P+p)*Q+q]=m;}}

kernels.name: avg_pool2d_forward
kernels.kernel: __global__ void avgpool2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int KH, int KW, int P, int Q){int n=blockIdx.z, c=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x/Q, q=blockIdx.x%Q; float sum=0; int cnt=0; for(int kh=0;kh<KH;++kh){for(int kw=0;kw<KW;++kw){int h=p+kh, w_=q+kw; if(h<H&&w_<W){sum+=x[((n*C+c)*H+h)*W+w_]; cnt++;}}} y[((n*C+c)*P+p)*Q+q]=sum/cnt;}}

kernels.name: softmax
kernels.kernel: __global__ void softmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int n){extern __shared__ float smem[]; int tid=threadIdx.x; float maxv=-FLT_MAX; for(int i=tid;i<n;i+=blockDim.x) maxv=fmaxf(maxv,x[i]); smem[tid]=maxv; __syncthreads(); for(int s=blockDim.x>>1;s>0;s>>=1){ if(tid<s) smem[tid]=fmaxf(smem[tid],smem[tid+s]); __syncthreads();} float m=smem[0], sum=0; for(int i=tid;i<n;i+=blockDim.x) sum+=expf(x[i]-m); smem[tid]=sum; __syncthreads(); for(int s=blockDim.x>>1;s>0;s>>=1){ if(tid<s) smem[tid]+=smem[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} float denom=smem[0]; for(int i=tid;i<n;i+=blockDim.x) y[i]=expf(x[i]-m)/denom;}}

kernels.name: batchnorm_forward
kernels.pytorch: y = torch.batch_norm(x, running_mean, running_var, weight, bias, training)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void batchnorm_fw_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, const float* __restrict__ mean, const float* __restrict__ var, const float* __restrict__ gamma, const float* __restrict__ beta, float eps, int N){int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<N){float norm=(x[idx]-mean[0])*rsqrtf(var[0]+eps); y[idx]=gamma[0]*norm+beta[0];}}

kernels.name: layernorm_forward
kernels.pytorch: y = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, normalized_shape, weight, bias, eps)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void layernorm_fw_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, const float* __restrict__ gamma, const float* __restrict__ beta, int M, int N, float eps){extern __shared__ float sm[]; int row=blockIdx.x, tid=threadIdx.x; float mean=0; for(int i=tid;i<N;i+=blockDim.x) mean+=x[row*N+i]; sm[tid]=mean; __syncthreads(); for(int s=blockDim.x>>1; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sm[tid]+=sm[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} mean=sm[0]/N; float var=0; for(int i=tid;i<N;i+=blockDim.x){float v=x[row*N+i]-mean; var+=v*v;} sm[tid]=var; __syncthreads(); for(int s=blockDim.x>>1; s>0; s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sm[tid]+=sm[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} var=sm[0]/N; float inv_std=rsqrtf(var+eps); for(int i=tid;i<N;i+=blockDim.x){int idx=row*N+i; float norm=(x[idx]-mean)*inv_std; y[idx]=norm*gamma[i]+beta[i];}}

kernels.name: dropout_forward
kernels.kernel: __global__ void dropout_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, unsigned int seed, float p, int n){int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<n){curandStatePhilox4_32_10_t st; curand_init(seed, idx,0,&st); float r=curand_uniform(&st); float scale=r>p?1.0f/(1.0f-p):0.0f; y[idx]=x[idx]*scale;}}

kernels.name: transpose
kernels.kernel: __global__ void transpose_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int rows, int cols){int i=blockIdx.y*blockDim.y+threadIdx.y, j=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(i<rows&&j<cols) y[j*rows+i]=x[i*cols+j];}

kernels.name: gather
kernels.kernel: __global__ void gather_kernel(const float* __restrict__ src, const int64_t* __restrict__ idx, float* __restrict__ dst, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(i<n) dst[i]=src[idx[i]];}

kernels.name: scatter_add
kernels.kernel: __global__ void scatter_add_kernel(float* __restrict__ dst, const int64_t* __restrict__ idx, const float* __restrict__ src, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(i<n) atomicAdd(&dst[idx[i]], src[i]);}

kernels.name: dot_product
kernels.kernel: __global__ void dot_kernel(const float* __restrict__ a, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ out){extern __shared__ float sdata[]; unsigned int tid=threadIdx.x, i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x*2+tid; float sum=0; if(i<N){sum=a[i]*b[i]+(i+blockDim.x<N?a[i+blockDim.x]*b[i+blockDim.x]:0);} sdata[tid]=sum; __syncthreads(); for(unsigned s=blockDim.x/2;s>0;s>>=1){ if(tid<s) sdata[tid]+=sdata[tid+s]; __syncthreads();} if(tid==0) atomicAdd(out, sdata[0]);}

kernels.name: matrix_vector_multiplication
kernels.kernel: __global__ void matvec_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ x, float* __restrict__ y, int M, int N){int row=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(row<M){float sum=0; for(int j=0;j<N;++j) sum+=A[row*N+j]*x[j]; y[row]=sum;}}

kernels.name: matrix_scalar_multiplication
kernels.kernel: __global__ void mat_scalar_mul_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, float scalar, float* __restrict__ out, int n){int idx=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(idx<n) out[idx]=A[idx]*scalar;}

kernels.name: batched_matrix_multiplication
kernels.kernel: __global__ void batched_gemm_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ B, float* __restrict__ C, int Batches, int M, int N, int K){int batch=blockIdx.z, row=blockIdx.y*blockDim.y+threadIdx.y, col=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(batch<Batches&&row<M&&col<N){float sum=0; const float* A_batch=A+batch*M*K; const float* B_batch=B+batch*K*N; for(int k=0;k<K;++k) sum+=A_batch[row*K+k]*B_batch[k*N+col]; C[(batch*M+row)*N+col]=sum;}}

kernels.name: 3D_tensor_matrix_multiplication
kernels.kernel: __global__ void tensor3d_matmul_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ B, float* __restrict__ C, int Batches, int M, int N, int K){int batch=blockIdx.z, row=blockIdx.y*blockDim.y+threadIdx.y, col=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(batch<Batches&&row<M&&col<N){float sum=0; const float* A_batch=A+batch*M*K; for(int k=0;k<K;++k) sum+=A_batch[row*K+k]*B[k*N+col]; C[(batch*M+row)*N+col]=sum;}}

kernels.name: matmul_transposed_A
kernels.kernel: __global__ void gemm_transA_kernel(const float* __restrict__ A, const float* __restrict__ B, float* __restrict__ C, int M, int N, int K){int row=blockIdx.y*blockDim.y+threadIdx.y, col=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(row<K&&col<N){float sum=0; for(int m=0;m<M;++m) sum+=A[m*K+row]*B[m*N+col]; C[row*N+col]=sum;}}

kernels.name: conv2d_asymmetric_kernel
kernels.pytorch: out = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, weight, bias, stride, padding, dilation)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv2d_asym_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q, int stride_h, int stride_w, int pad_h, int pad_w, int dilation_h, int dilation_w){int n=blockIdx.z, k=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x/Q, q=blockIdx.x%Q; float sum=b?b[k]:0; for(int c=0;c<C;++c){for(int r=0;r<R;++r){for(int s=0;s<S;++s){int h=p*stride_h-pad_h+r*dilation_h, w_ = q*stride_w-pad_w+s*dilation_w; if(h>=0&&h<H&&w_>=0&&w_<W) sum += x[((n*C + c)*H + h)*W + w_] * w[((k*C + c)*R + r)*S + s];}}} y[((n*K + k)*P + p)*Q + q] = sum;}}

kernels.name: conv_transposed_2d
kernels.pytorch: out = torch.nn.functional.conv_transpose2d(x, weight, bias, stride, padding, dilation)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv_transpose2d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int H, int W, int K, int R, int S, int P, int Q, int stride_h, int stride_w, int pad_h, int pad_w, int dilation_h, int dilation_w){int n=blockIdx.z, k=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x/Q, q=blockIdx.x%Q; float sum=b?b[k]:0; for(int c=0;c<C;++c){for(int r=0;r<R;++r){for(int s=0;s<S;++s){int h=(p+pad_h-r*dilation_h)/stride_h, w_=(q+pad_w-s*dilation_w)/stride_w; if(h*stride_h==p+pad_h-r*dilation_h&&w_*stride_w==q+pad_w-s*dilation_w&&h>=0&&h<H&&w_>=0&&w_<W){sum += x[((n*C + c)*H + h)*W + w_] * w[((c*K + k)*R + r)*S + s];}}} y[((n*K + k)*P + p)*Q + q] = sum;}}

kernels.name: conv_transposed_1d
kernels.pytorch: out = torch.nn.functional.conv_transpose1d(x, weight, bias, stride, padding, dilation)
kernels.kernel: __global__ void conv_transpose1d_kernel(const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w, const float* __restrict__ b, float* __restrict__ y, int N, int C, int L, int K, int R, int P, int stride, int pad, int dilation){int n=blockIdx.z, k=blockIdx.y, p=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; if(p<P){float sum=b?b[k]:0; for(int c=0;c<C;++c){for(int r=0;r<R;++r){int l=(p+pad-r*dilation)/stride; if(l*stride==p+pad-r*dilation&&l>=0&&l<L){sum += x[(n*C + c)*L + l] * w[(c*K + k)*R + r];}}} y[(n*K + k)*P + p] = sum;}}
